title: The Fairy Pools
opening: The fairies are all sick. Something is poisoning the water! Your wand holds fairy light. Clean the five pools, one by one.
not_yet: Not that pool. The fairies are still sick. Follow the clue!

steps.clue: Start at the pool under the Old Oak. The water is dark and still. Wave your wand and make it sparkle!
Next, the spring by the Mushroom Ring. The frogs stopped singing. Wave your wand and wake them up!
Now the pool inside the Dark Cave. It smells funny in there. Hold your wand high and clean it!
The Waterfall is dripping black goo. Stand where the water falls. Wave your wand and wash it away!
One pool left. The Fairy Spring by the Throne. Clean it and the fairies will wake up!

ending: The water runs clear! The fairies open their eyes and stretch their wings. But who poisoned the water? The Fairy Guide says a crystal is missing from the Crystal Caves. Let's go find out who stole it!
